steps.name: Dimensionar
steps.task: Read the request, the project sheets and the product notes. Say how big the work is (S, M or L) and why, and what decisions nobody has taken yet.

steps.name: Partir
steps.task: Write the epic and split it into user stories, each with its project, size and acceptance criteria, and each story into tasks with who does them. No story may be L.

steps.name: Escrever as issues
steps.task: Write the exact title, body, type, labels, repository and parent of every issue, in the user's language.

steps.name: Aprovação
steps.task: Show the user every issue exactly as it will be written and wait for an explicit yes. Quote the user's exact words in "userWords". Never infer a yes.

steps.name: Criar as issues
steps.task: Create the approved issues with gh, link stories to the epic and tasks to their story as sub-issues, and give the link of each one.
